THE HONOURABLE SRI JUSTICE NYAPATHY VIJAY
WRIT PETITION NO: 26698 OF 2025

Between:

P.Naveen, S/o.Radha Krishna, Aged about 37 years, R/o.H.No.13-46,
Kothapeta Avanigadda Mandal, Krishna District.

## AND

1. The State of Andhra Pradesh, Represented by its Principal Secretary
School Education Department Secretariat Buildings, Velagapudi, Guntur
District.

2. Commissioner and Director of School Education, Mangalagiri, Guntur
District.

3. MEGA DSC-2025, Rep. by its Convener, Mangalagiri, Guntur District.

4. District Educational Officer, Krishna, at Machilipatnam.

...Respondents

WHEREAS the Petitioner above named through his Advocate
M/s. ADAPA RAMYA SAHITHI NAIDU presented this Petition under Article

226 of the Constitution of India praying that in the circumstances stated in the
affidavit filed therewith, the High Court may be pleased to issue a Writ, Order
or Direction, more particularly one in the nature of Writ of Mandamus declaring
the action of the respondents in not considering the case of the petitioner for
appointment to the post of School Assistant (Social Studies) in Krishna District
or to the post of TGT (Telugu) in Zone-II and appointing less meritorious
candidates than the petitioner herein is wholly illegal, arbitrary and violative of
Article 14, 16 and 21 of the Constitution of India and consequently declare that
the petitioner is entitled to be considered for appointment to the post of School
Assistant (Social Studies) in Krishna District or to the post of TGT (Telugu) in
Zone-II.

AND WHEREAS the High Court upon perusing the petition and
affidavit filed herein and upon hearing the arguments of M/s.ADAPA RAMYA
SAHITHI NAIDU Advocate for the Petitioner, directed issue of notice to the
Respondents returnable in four weeks herein to show cause as to why this
WRIT PETITION should not be admitted.

You viz:

1. The Principal Secretary, School Education Department, State of Andhra
2. Pradesh, Secretariat Buildings, Velagapudi, Guntur District.
3. Commissioner and Director of School Education, Mangalagiri, Guntur
4. District.
5. The Convener, MEGA DSC-2025, Mangalagiri, Guntur District.
6. District Educational Officer, Krishna, at Machilipatnam.

are be and hereby directed to show cause either appearing in person or
through an Advocate, as to why in the circumstances set out in the petition
and the affidavit filed therewith (copy enclosed) this WRIT PETITION should
not be admitted, on or before 24.10.2025, on which date the case stands
posted for hearing.

## IA NO: 1 OF 2025

Petition under Section 151 CPC is filed praying that in the
circumstances stated in the affidavit filed in support of the petition, the High
Court may be pleased to direct the respondents to include petitioner's name in
the final selection list published for post of School Assistant (Social Studies) in
Krishna District and also in final selection list of TGT (Telugu) in APSWREIS
and also in APTWREIS in Zone-II, pending disposal of WP No. 26698 of 2025,
on the file of the High Court.

## IA NO: 2 OF 2025

Petition under Section 151 CPC is filed praying that in the
circumstances stated in the affidavit filed in support of the petition, the High
Court may be pleased to direct the respondents to reserve one post of School
Assistant (Social Studies) in Krishna District, one post of TGT (Telugu) in
Zone-II in APSWREIS and one post of TGT (Telugu) in APTWREIS, pending
disposal of WP No. 26698 of 2025, on the file of the High Court.

## HON'BLE SRI JUSTICE NYAPATHY VIJAY

## W.P.No.26698 of 2025

## ORDER:

Notice before admission, returnable in four weeks.

2. In the present Writ Petition, the Petitioner is questioning
the action of the Respondents in not considering the case of
the Petitioner for the post of School Assistant (Social Studies)
in Krishna District or to the post of TGT (Telugu) in Zone-II
pursuant to DSC Notification-2025 dated 20.04.2025.
3. Sri G. Ramachandra Rao, learned Government Pleader,
would submit that there is no violation in the selection process
and that the selections are in accordance with the Rules in
vogue and no error is committed by the Respondents. The
learned Government Pleader further submits that a Grievance
Committee has been constituted vide Memo
No.2984388/Services.I/A1/2025-1, dated 24.09.2025 and the
Petitioner can ventilate his grievance before the relevant
committee.
4. Heard respective counsel.

4. Heard respective counsel.

5. The learned Government Pleader further submits that

2 the Respondent No.1 had issued a Memo No.2984388/Services.I/A1/2025-1, dated 24.09.2025 providing Grievance Redressal Committees with regard to complaints in the selection process pursuant to the DSC Notification, 2025. According to the Memo, there is a Zonal Level Grievance Committee and a State Level Grievance Committee apart from an Appellate Grievance Authority. The guidelines of the Zonal and State Level Committees are extracted below in tabular form:

According to the memo, this mechanism is to ensure transparency in the selection process and to redress the grievances of the aspirants. 6. In the opinion of this Court, the Petitioner can avail the opportunity and give an application to the Zonal Level Grievance Committee, which would consider the grievance of the Petitioner, and an appropriate decision would be communicated to the Petitioner within the time line prescribed in the tabular form, which is extracted above. 7. Therefore, without expressing prima facie opinion regarding entitlement of the Petitioner, the following interim order is passed: i) The Petitioner shall submit an application explaining his grievance to the Zonal Level Grievance Committee through the email address as provided by the Respondent Authorities within the time fixed. ii) On receipt of the complaint from the Petitioner, the

4

௨௪

Zonal Level Grievance Committee shall examine the
same and pass appropriate orders thereon within the
time frame specified.

iii) In the event, there are complicated facts and legal
issues in any grievance received, the Committee
may also take the opinion of domain experts before
making the decisions.

iv) The Respondents shall also consider to keep certain
number of posts unfilled to enable effective
implementation of the grievance committee order
and orders of this Court rather than annulling the
appointments of appointees under DSC-2025
notification, which would lead to further
complications.

v) The Orders of the Grievance Committee shall be
communicated to the email of the Petitioner also.

vi) The decision of the Committee will be subject to
further orders of this Court.

vii) Any appointment to the post to which the Petitioner
is aspiring will be subject to further orders of this
Court.

8. Post on 24.10.2025 for filing Counter Affidavits by
the Respondents.
